newsitem.title: USA: Dow pares losses, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow pares losses, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: The Dow industrials pulled back from an early-morning decline of about 60 points and were off about 21 points at 7740.
The Nasdaq composite was down about five points to 1438.
Analysts said Wall Street was under pressure from the technology sector, which saw two key players issue earnings warnings late Tuesday.
The New York Stock Exchange lifted curbs on index-arbitrage trades at 0952 EDT/1352 GMT.

Gateway 2000 Inc, the computer maker, said it expects flat second-quarter revenues compared with the first quarter due to weaker demand. Seagate Technology Inc, a maker of disk drives, said it saw fourth-quarter results below expectations.
Gateway shares were down 2-1/2 to 32-1/4 while Seagate shares shed 5-3/8 to 36.
Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co, said pressure from the technology stocks was affecting the market but would not drag it too far down.
"We're starting to see some bargain-hunting today," he said. "The market is appearing to hold its gains nicely."
